title: Consider physical-world inspiration for a nearby interaction

statement.en: Consider a task's physical-world perspective when designing a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interactionを設計するときtaskのphysical-world perspectiveを検討する。

conditions: Look for physical actions that can make the task feel easy, natural, and engaging.
exceptions: Device-to-device media transfer is an example, not a required interaction model.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Nearby interactions experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるNearby interactionsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use available proximity and context information

statement.en: Use available distance, direction, and context to inform a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: 利用可能なdistance、direction、contextをnearby interactionに反映する。

conditions: iPhone provides peer-device distance and direction; Apple Watch provides peer-device distance.
exceptions: Contact suggestion is an example, not a required nearby-interaction feature.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Nearby interactions experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Consider proximity-responsive nearby feedback

statement.en: Consider changing nearby-interaction feedback as physical distance changes.
statement.ja: physical distanceの変化に合わせてnearby-interaction feedbackを変えることを検討する。

conditions: Mirror the way perception typically becomes more precise at closer distances.
exceptions: The documented locator transition is an example, not a required visual treatment.

title: Provide continuous nearby-interaction feedback

statement.en: Provide continuous feedback during a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interaction中はcontinuous feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Keep feedback uninterrupted and responsive to people's movement.
Use continuous updates to strengthen the connection between the physical task and the interaction.
exceptions: Direction-and-proximity updates are an example, not a requirement on platforms without direction data.
